title: feat(lint): warn on a private synced object no sharing rule grants read on
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBSuKf8VhsAoZVdHShKeFRCV)_
Fixes #32122
Part of #31763

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #32065 (`content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx`, the `synced` row of the Lifecycle bucket table, says nothing about the sharing model a synced object needs; no `skills/**` file teaches synced sharing)
Prior rulings read: synced,sharingmodel,sharingrules,security-owd-unset → 11 hits; ADR-0055 Decision §1, ADR-0055 Decision §4, ADR-0056 D1, ADR-0056 D9, ADR-0057 D6, ADR-0090 D1, ADR-0090 D4, ADR-0153 D4, ADR-0153 D8; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新增一条编写期警告 `security-synced-private-unreadable`：`managedBy: 'synced'` 且 `sharingModel: 'private'` 的对象，如果栈里没有任何授予读取的共享规则，`os validate` / `os compile` / `os dev` 会给出警告，修复提示与 `security-owd-unset` 给同步对象的两条出路完全一致。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0153 D4 裁定。同步写入的行没有所有者，`private` 下成员只能看到自己拥有或被共享的行，所以没有共享规则时成员列表永远为空，作者只能从空列表里发现问题。
- **风险与回滚**：只是警告，不拒收任何以前接受的元数据，不碰 spec 与运行时；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-synced-private-readability.ts`（判定"授予读取"的三个条件）、`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`（注册为 advisory、仅 CLI）、`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`（`os explain` 条目）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-synced-private-readability.test.ts`，预期 9 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New advisory rule `security-synced-private-unreadable`** in its own file, `packages/lint/src/validate-synced-private-readability.ts` (a new file, so it does not meet open PR #32034 in `validate-security-posture.ts`). It fires on an object with `managedBy: 'synced'` and `sharingModel: 'private'` when no sharing rule in the stack grants read on it, at `objects[N].sharingModel`, severity `warning`.
- **Fix line:** `SYNCED_OBJECT_WAY_OUT`, imported from `validate-security-posture.ts`, not copied. The two remedies therefore read exactly as `security-owd-unset` prints them for a synced object, and they follow any later edit of that constant.
- **What "grants read" means (pinned):** a `stack.sharingRules[]` entry whose `object` names the object, that is not `active: false` (plugin-sharing's `rule-hooks.ts` skips an inactive rule), and whose `accessLevel` is `read` or `edit`, or absent (the schema default is `read`). Any recipient and any `condition` count; whether a condition lowers is `validateSharingRuleEnforceability`'s error, so it is not judged twice.
- **An UNSET `sharingModel` on a synced object does not fire.** Measured: that object already gets the `security-owd-unset` error, and its hint is `SYNCED_OBJECT_WAY_OUT`, the same two remedies. One finding, not two (pinned).
- **Object extensions:** nothing to fold. `ObjectExtensionSchema` is strict and carries neither `sharingModel` nor `managedBy`, and sharing rules are a stack collection, so no extension can change the verdict. The rule reads `stack.objects` and `stack.sharingRules` as the D1/D4 loop of `validateSecurityPosture` reads `stack.objects`.
- **Registration:** `authoring-rules.ts` entry `validateSyncedPrivateReadability` (`tier: 'advisory'`, `input: 'parsed'`, all three commands, CLI only with `RUNTIME_NEEDS_FULL_SNAPSHOT`: the per-write snapshot does not carry `sharingRules`); `rule-explanations.ts` entry (`os explain security-synced-private-unreadable`); the rule id and validator exported from the `@objectstack/lint` barrel. No generated rule census or doc names lint rule ids, so nothing is regenerated.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/lint` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `check-changeset-no-major` computes `patch` for `none`: a first draft graded it `minor` and the gate refused it (exit 1) before the PR opened.
- **Docs transcripts:** the four `os validate` / `os build` transcripts that quote the author-time rule count now say 65 (was 64), as `check:docs-transcript-drift` derives from the registry: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx`.

## Tests

`packages/lint/src/validate-synced-private-readability.test.ts`, 9 cases: fires on the bare pair (hint is `SYNCED_OBJECT_WAY_OUT`); silent with a read-granting rule (`read`, `edit`, absent level, another recipient type); still fires when the only rule is inactive; still fires when the only read-granting rule is on another object; silent on `public_read` and `public_read_write`; silent on a non-synced private object; silent on an unset model, which is `security-owd-unset` with the synced hint; an `os explain` entry exists; through `runAuthoringRules` on a `defineStack`-parsed stack it lands in advisories, not errors, and a read-granting rule clears it.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' build` under os-verify-lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` under os-verify-lock: `Test Files 199 passed (199)`, `Tests 8396 passed | 5 skipped (8401)`; typecheck and `check:test-typecheck` OK; `VERDICT command-exit 0`. (Run at 17a44a2d; the later commits touch only the changeset and four docs transcripts, no file under `packages/`.)

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one mutation, restored)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/lint/src/validate-synced-private-readability.ts --anchor 'if (granted.has(name)) return;' --replacement 'return; /* ABLATED-32122 */' -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-synced-private-readability.test.ts`

- mutation landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob `b688dea782cf` → `ebe4b4de3fa6`;
- result: `Tests 4 failed | 5 passed (9)`: the bare pair, the inactive rule, the rule on another object, and the registry run turn red; the silent cases stay green, as they should;
- restored: blob == HEAD (`b688dea782cf`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- A first attempt with `--replacement 'return;'` was refused by the script before anything ran (the replacement text already occurred twice, so its count could not prove the mutation); it measured nothing.
- The test imports the rule from `src/` by a relative path, so no `dist/` build sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Permission-set read depth is not judged.** `readScope: 'org'` on the object makes plugin-sharing return no sharing filter (`sharing-service.ts`, `readScope === 'org'`), and `viewAllRecords` bypasses it too, so either also lets members read owner-less synced rows. D4 names the sharing rule as the remedy, and this rule reports D4's verdict as written, so a stack that relies on `readScope: 'org'` still gets the warning. The `os explain` entry says so. Raised in the report for the seat.
- **A sharing rule from another installed package** is not visible to a single-package stack; the warning is advisory for that reason, and `os explain` says to ignore it then.
- `docs/adr/0153-one-way-sync-in-beside-federation.md` on `main` still reads `Status: Proposed (2026-11-10)`; the card and the seat treat D4 as the accepted ruling.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **96** families at head `942bb4a3`; all 96 ran locally with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles: `96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

<details><summary>How the 96 were run</summary>

- 66 families derived at `3a2f1fc4` (code + changeset): 62 exit 0 on the first pass. Four exited 3 (prerequisite not met, nothing measured): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; passed after `git fetch origin 621a4876`), `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (no full build; both exit 0 after `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2` under os-verify-lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`), and `check:docs-transcript-drift` (lint not built; once built it reported the four stale transcripts, fixed in `bb1da376`, then exit 0).
- 30 families the docs commit added: all exit 0 at `bb1da376`.
- At `942bb4a3` (changeset regraded to patch) the families that read the changeset or the changed docs were run again: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:published-files`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: all exit 0.
- `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main --event` with this body as the `pull_request` payload: exit 0 (`LEVEL AXIS: ... a non-protocol change at patch`). Control, the same body declaring `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: exit 1, as it should.

</details>

CI families are cited from this PR's check-runs at hand-over.
